rule: STOP iff the current text contains an explicit quoted earlier report, the request is scoped to reflecting/acknowledging that report, and no separate historical question follows; otherwise request MS, subject to original legal mask/budget.
limitation: Explicit report/scope cue is not semantic proof that G will complete every required fact or support goal. Current English pattern is restricted; unrecognized paraphrases fall back to MS.

independent_validation.status: protocol proposal only; no source text read or new task/G package constructed
independent_validation.exclusion: All six J06 source families and their sessions/variants are excluded from independent policy validation.
independent_validation.reserve: Historical test fold 6 remains sealed (three owner families). If those sources have prior exposure in another line, disclose it; independence from J06 is not universal unseen-data status.
independent_validation.source_rule: Use the existing source registry and strict AsOf legality. Freeze source identities, task/reference/scorer and wording before any new generation; do not choose from generated successes.
conditions: current report explicitly sufficient for requested fields
historical fact absent from current view
current report partial or a separate history question
independent_validation.wording: Multiple prewritten paraphrases; include exact and unquoted/current-dialogue forms, extra history requirements, and incomplete or conflicting visible material. Do not give every positive case the J06 supplied-in-full marker.
independent_validation.required_answer: Make any required exact fact explicit in the new controlled task; keep a distinct natural-support track where exhaustive fact restatement is not automatically necessary.
evaluation: paired task completion and new errors
input/output tokens and actual total latency separately
independent_validation.inference: At most three held-out source families give limited precision; report group results, no iid task confidence interval or automatic noninferiority claim.
independent_validation.stop_rule: Any confirmed success loss or unresolved safety/meaning tradeoff defeats an unqualified cost-saving claim. Retain results; no same-set rule retuning or task replacement.

sequential_claim: No read-conditioned next-resource decision or matched OneShot comparison exists in J06. C1 is a static acquisition candidate, not a sequential policy.
